newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Kothari to launch fixed-income schemes.
newsitem.headline: India's Kothari to launch fixed-income schemes.

text.p: Indian mutual fund Kothari Pioneer said on Wednesday it planned to launch two fixed-income schemes later this month.
Kothari Pioneer Money Market Account -- which will invest in money market instruments like call money, treasury bills and commercial paper -- opens for subscription on February 24.
Kothari Pioneer Pension Plan -- to be launched on February 27 -- is an open-ended debt fund.

"Though Kothari Pioneer Mutual Fund is not offering any guaranteed returns on this scheme, the asset management company will not charge any fees if the net asset value is less than 11.40 rupees at the end of the first year," the firm said in a statement.
The fund recently launched Kothari Pioneer Guaranteed Income Plan, a five-year closed-ended fund with an assured return of 15 percent annually.
